text: Friendship, in which, unless you both see and show an open breast, to use a common expression, you can neither trust nor be certain of anything, no, not even of mutual affection, since you cannot be sure of its sincerity.
author: Marcus Tullius Cicero
speaker: Laelius
reference: Treatises on Friendship and Old Age
location: Rome or his villa at Tusculum, Italy (presumed)
